JM.title: I became a mother at just 16 years old. While other girls my age were focused on school, friendships, and figuring out who they wanted to become, my life suddenly changed. I became pregnant, dropped out of school, and had to grow up much faster than I ever expected.I became a single mother, and there were days when I felt scared, overwhelmed, and unsure of what the future would look like. I had to learn how to be strong even when I didn’t feel strong. I had to make sacrifices, face challenges, and keep going when giving up sometimes felt easier.But one thing I never gave up on was my son and the life I wanted for both of us.I may not have taken the path I imagined when I was younger, but becoming a mother gave me a reason to fight harder. Every struggle, every setback, every tear, and every difficult season taught me something. I started learning that my circumstances did not have to determine my future.I’ve made mistakes. I’ve had moments where I questioned myself. I’ve had times when life felt heavy. But I kept trying. I kept dreaming. I kept working toward becoming a better version of myself and creating a better life for my son.Today, I look back at that 16-year-old girl and I’m proud of her. She didn’t have all the answers. She didn’t know how everything would work out. But she kept going.My story isn’t about becoming a teenage mother or dropping out of school. My story is about what happened afterward. It’s about resilience, sacrifice, motherhood, growth, and refusing to let my beginning decide my ending.I’m still building. I’m still learning. I’m still healing. I’m still chasing my dreams.And no matter how many times life knocks me down, I will always get back up not just for myself, but for the little boy who gave me a reason to never stop fighting for a better life. This is my story. And I’m not finished yet.💙🙃
JM.author: asha_talk_about

GLOBAL.title: I became a mother at just 16 years old. While other girls my age were focused on school, friendships, and figuring out who they wanted to become, my life suddenly changed. I became pregnant, dropped out of school, and had to grow up much faster than I ever expected.I became a single mother, and there were days when I felt scared, overwhelmed, and unsure of what the future would look like. I had to learn how to be strong even when I didn’t feel strong. I had to make sacrifices, face challenges, and keep going when giving up sometimes felt easier.But one thing I never gave up on was my son and the life I wanted for both of us.I may not have taken the path I imagined when I was younger, but becoming a mother gave me a reason to fight harder. Every struggle, every setback, every tear, and every difficult season taught me something. I started learning that my circumstances did not have to determine my future.I’ve made mistakes. I’ve had moments where I questioned myself. I’ve had times when life felt heavy. But I kept trying. I kept dreaming. I kept working toward becoming a better version of myself and creating a better life for my son.Today, I look back at that 16-year-old girl and I’m proud of her. She didn’t have all the answers. She didn’t know how everything would work out. But she kept going.My story isn’t about becoming a teenage mother or dropping out of school. My story is about what happened afterward. It’s about resilience, sacrifice, motherhood, growth, and refusing to let my beginning decide my ending.I’m still building. I’m still learning. I’m still healing. I’m still chasing my dreams.And no matter how many times life knocks me down, I will always get back up not just for myself, but for the little boy who gave me a reason to never stop fighting for a better life. This is my story. And I’m not finished yet.💙🙃
